question.text: Disciplinary proceedings against an empanelled SIA for professional misconduct (e.g., accepting an engagement without independence, issuing a false certificate) are primarily adjudicated by:

answer.text: The Ministry of Corporate Affairs - National Financial Reporting Authority.
ICAI's Social Impact Assessment Standards Board (SIAB) disciplinary mechanism.
The Reserve Bank of India - Department of Supervision.

explanation.text: The Logic: SIAs are empanelled with the ICAI Social Impact Assessment Standards Board (SIAB), which is the notified SRO for SIAs. SIAB's disciplinary mechanism handles complaints against empanelled members through complaint intake, preliminary enquiry, show-cause, hearing and order, with appeal to an appellate authority. ICMAI, NFRA and RBI have no SIAB-equivalent jurisdiction here. The Trap: ICMAI is not the SIA SRO (a common mis-map from cost-audit context). NFRA's mandate covers listed-audit firms only. RBI covers banking supervision. Cross-Exam Context: V-B basics, X-A/X-B IA exams and XXIII all test ICAI's role; only XXIII tests SIAB-specific disciplinary architecture. Assessor's Pro-Tip: Keep a personal compliance file containing current empanelment certificate, CPE credits, continuing-obligation returns and any client-complaint responses. SIAB's preliminary enquiry officer calls for this file - a well-organised one shortens the enquiry cycle significantly.
